intro: Archmage Theocritus is an eccentric human wizard who resides at the peak of the Tower of Azora in eastern Elwynn Forest. He lives independently, surrounded by servants and magical scrying devices. From his high sanctum, Theocritus directs his arcane talents toward keeping watch over the kingdom and combating his dark rival, the rogue mage Morganth.

p: Archmage Theocritus keeps an independent stronghold in the kingdom of Stormwind. He settled in the prominent Tower of Azora, situated near the eastern road to Redridge. Theocritus is known for his eccentric habits and comfortable lifestyle, employing an extensive household staff that includes numerous gnomish attendants and his own dedicated clothier, Morley Eberlein. Though he keeps himself largely detached from the mundane concerns of local villagers, his presence serves as a critical magical bulwark in eastern Elwynn.

Theocritus's greatest ongoing concern is the fallen mage Morganth, a dangerous warlock operating from the Tower of Ilgalar in the nearby Redridge Mountains. Viewing Morganth both as a personal nemesis and a severe peril to Stormwind, Theocritus has dedicated months of arcane research to undermining him. Through scrying artifacts like the Eye of Azora, Theocritus monitors the villain's actions and delves into his thoughts. He also works to turn Morganth's own creations against him, studying the magical pendants carried by the Shadowhide gnolls in hopes of transmitting an arcane pulse that can immobilize the entire pack.
